correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md, verifier and source-tree blobs. Cyclic Fourier eigendirections give five projective candidates: the trivial one is off the quartic, four lie on it. At v_k the derivative eliminates the eigenline v_{2k}; after removing the projective radial line the tangent weights are (-k,2k,3k), generator-equivalent to (1,2,3). All four Reid–Tai sums for nontrivial powers are 6,7,8,9>5, proving four terminal points and Cartier index 5. The action is free outside those points. Quasi-etale degree-five canonical pullback gives 4/5 anticanonical volume and Fano positivity; rational invariant H^2 yields rho=1. Griffiths Jacobian ring degree-three monomials are precisely 30 nonpure cubes, forming six free C5-orbits, hence invariant h21=6 and b3=12; pure Hodge follows rational finite-quotient transfer. Chern c3=-14H^3 yields chi(X)=-56; Burnside and commuting-pair counts give chi(Y)=-8 and orbifold chi=8. Independent exact check reconstructed 4 quotient points, 6 cubic monomial orbits and the Betti/Euler arithmetic. No claim of integral quotient cohomology or crepant resolution.
